items.title: Persist and reconcile managed host-run lifecycle
items.context: Introduce the deep ManagedHostRun module with immutable spec/owner/claim, one-shot prompt capability, snapshots/events/live output, absolute deadline, cooperative cancel, exclusive terminal receipt, next-touch reconciliation, replacementSafe, retention and runtimeContinuation semantics. Silence alone never fails or restarts a run.

items.title: Expose submit, attach, status and cancel command surfaces
items.context: Make foreground host_run submit-and-attach over the durable run, add detach submission with claim handshake, bounded host_run_status long-poll, idempotent host_run_cancel, and a hidden worker continuation. Keep text/json passthrough contracts and prompt secrecy.

items.title: Supervise provider processes portably and honestly
items.context: Use POSIX process groups for TERM/KILL/reap/residual checks, fail before spawn on unsupported platforms, launch Codex with documented explicit stdin -, preserve provider usage parsing and configured timeout ceilings, and separate worker heartbeat from provider progress visibility.

items.title: Enforce shared provider admission independent of usage-ledger mode
items.context: All provider-process launch sites must acquire the same bounded slot registry even when usage accounting is disabled. Preserve ledger fail-closed behavior, candidate-spec streaming/retention semantics, and explicitly classify remaining migrated/unmanaged execution surfaces.

items.title: Route cross-host review through managed execution
items.context: cross_host_review retains snapshot/policy/redacted-env/structured-verdict ownership but delegates execution to ManagedHostRun under the privileged cross-host-verdict profile, attaches to terminal truth, validates verdict shape, and preserves existing timeout policy ceiling and fail-closed semantics.

items.title: Bind formal reviewer evidence to exact managed receipts
items.context: Extend dispatch/reviewer evidence contracts so CLI-provider reviewer pass/finding claims bind to a sealed managed run receipt and evidence journal with exact story/reviewRun/lane/provider/prompt-envelope/material bindings. Raw CLI and heuristic time-window ledger matches cannot satisfy managed evidence; structured degraded decisions remain explicit.

items.title: Add adversarial coverage, observability, migration docs and rollout controls
items.context: Test background continuation beyond caller lifetime, silent-but-live runs, worker crash with deadline reconciliation, cancellation races, process-tree cleanup, slot contention with ledger off, candidate overflow, forged/stale receipts and protected timeout preservation. Document operator status/cancel/recovery, legacy_unmanaged classification, trust boundary and rollout compatibility.
